_comment: Akshara ERP — canonical LIVE release configuration (A1: live-as-default). Consumed via `flutter build --release --dart-define-from-file=config/live_release.json`. APP_ENV=production hardens auth/TLS; anonymous OTP login still works (auth_dio_provider allows it). Only module flags with a verified live backend are enabled here — org-builder / platform-intelligence / verticals are intentionally OFF (no backend yet; would 404). Differentiation modules with confirmed-real backends (EDUCATION, INTELLIGENCE, AI_COPILOT, EVOLUTION=parent-insights, DIRECTOR, CONTROL_CENTER) are ON.
